anomaly_label: Overshooting pressure-control response of vacuum throttle valve (TV1)

evidence.observation: Jumps 69.5→72.3→82.8 °C within 3 min, then plateaus, while T712/T705 drop — top-section temperature profile breaks
System pressure drops abruptly from ~556 to ~508-519 mbar at k=19-20 after steady ~545-555
Spike to 3.28 mbar at k=19 then fall to 1.23 mbar
Both flows step up at k=19 (0.209→0.294, 0.414→0.619) coincident with pressure loss

args.missing_evidence: Distillate/overhead composition measurement; leak check of condenser/receiver seals and vacuum integrity; confirmation that T711 sensor is not faulty (independent top-stage temperature).
